text:
Hawk, Calatañazor,
toy.
Your gate, a lesser arch,
is so narrow
that no Moor on horseback enters,
and on foot an arrow cannot fit.

Dismount, Almanzor.
Flee quickly.

Down the rugged ravine,
ah, how it tumbled,
toy,
the drum.

translation.title: Hawk, Calatañazor...
